title: Migration windows and interoperability roadmap for Private/VPC/on-prem (Quarterly cadence)
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Goal: Define and publish a repeatable quarterly roadmap that coordinates customer migration windows, interoperability testing matrices, and upgrade rollback policies for Private (VPC/on-prem) customers.

Why: Customers on Private/Dedicated plans are requesting predictable, low-risk maintenance windows paired with clear compatibility guarantees across network topologies, KMS/HSM variants, and host OS/container runtimes. The initiative reduces surprise regressions, supports enterprise compliance needs, and lowers support cost by making upgrades predictable.

Scope:
- Quarterly published migration window schedule (regionalized) and cadence guidance for customers and account teams.
- An interoperability compatibility matrix covering common KMS integrations, CNI configurations, supported OS images, and accepted hypervisor/container runtimes.
- A canary/rollout playbook that ties Redwood Console rollouts to Private upgrade waves, automatic healthgate checks, and rollback criteria.
- UX/communications templates for account teams (maintenance notices, preflight checklists, post-upgrade health survey).

Out of scope for this ticket: detailed engineering work to implement each compatibility fix — those will be split into ENG tickets and prioritized via dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Public roadmap page published for 2026-Q2 migration windows with region-specific timeblocks and blackout periods
Interoperability matrix published as a living doc in Drive that lists supported KMS/HSM vendors, tested OS/container images, Helm chart/manifest versions, and known incompatibilities
Rollout playbook doc with step-by-step canary waves, health gates, automated rollback triggers, and ownership matrix is reviewed and accepted by SRE and Security
Customer-facing maintenance templates created and validated with two pilot accounts
Dependencies with ENG and Security tracked and triaged; at least 3 high-risk compatibility gaps have mitigation plans assigned
decisions: Adopt quarterly cadence for published migration windows rather than ad-hoc scheduling to reduce coordination overhead
Use region-local UTC windows and allow customers to opt-in for alternate windows via account teams
Require a signed preflight checklist for high-risk customers before scheduling an upgrade wave
risks: Late discovery of critical incompatibility (KMS or OS) that forces a migration window rollback
Customers in air-gapped or heavily regulated environments may require bespoke windows, increasing manual operations load
Coordination mismatch between engineering timelines and published windows could damage trust if rollouts are delayed
next_steps: Review interoperability matrix template with Applied ML and infra leads (owners: @infra-lead, @ml-ops) by 2026-01-20
Schedule pilot upgrades with two long-tail Private customers (account owners: Nadia Chen, Marco Ruiz) in February
Create Console feature request for showing migration window visibility in account settings (follow-up PM ticket if approved)
Formally link this roadmap to Dedicated/Rollouts OKR and surface to sales and support in the weekly GTM sync
